# Erdos.p912 — Erdős problem 912

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/912
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/912.lean`, theorem `erdos_912`, AMS 11).

Prove that there exists some $c>0$ such that
$$h(n) \sim c \left(\frac{n}{\log n}\right)^{1/2}$$
as $n\to \infty$.

## Statement
∃ c > 0,
    (fun n => (h n : ℝ)) ~[atTop] (fun n => c * (n / Real.log n) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
